units.source_text: 漫无目的地跑了一趟，岛村又回到了温泉浴场。

en.t: After wandering around aimlessly, Shimamura returned once more to the hot spring bathhouse.

units.source_text: 车子驶过那个岔口，一直开到守护神的杉林边上，眼前出现一间透着亮光的房子，岛村不禁松了一口气。

en.t: The car passed that fork in the road and went on to the edge of the guardian deity's cedar grove; when a house glowing with light appeared ahead, Shimamura could not help breathing a sigh of relief.
It was the small restaurant called Kikumura.

units.source_text: 三四个艺妓站在门前闲聊天。

en.t: Three or four geisha were standing in front of the door, chatting idly.
